settings.title: Apps & bots
settings.intro: Apps take part in chat like any member: add them to chats, groups and channels, DM them and @mention them. When someone mentions an app, writes to it or uses one of its commands, Zentico calls your server and the app can reply.
settings.claudeBody: Add your Claude to any conversation you're in and @mention it. It only listens to you: it runs your own Claude Code through your bridge, with the latest messages as context, and asks for your approval before sending, creating or sharing anything.
settings.noApps: You don't have any apps yet. Create one to connect your own service to chat.
settings.confirmDelete: Delete this app? It will leave every conversation and its token will stop working.
settings.confirmRotateSecret: Generate a new signing secret? The current one stops working right away.
settings.confirmRotateToken: Generate a new token? The current one stops working right away.
settings.copySecretsNow: Copy it now: you won't see it again.
settings.apiToken: App token (to post with the API)
settings.name: Name
settings.descriptionPlaceholder: What it does, in one sentence
settings.endpointHint: https:// only, on a public server (private and local IPs are not allowed). We wait up to 10 seconds for a response.
settings.sharedHint: Anyone can add it to their conversations. Otherwise only you can.
settings.commandsHint: Optional. For example /deploy: they show up when typing / in conversations the app is in.

guide.title: Developer guide
guide.intro: Two ways to connect services: incoming webhooks only post into one conversation; HTTP apps also receive events and can reply.
guide.webhooksBody: Create them in a conversation (Apps & webhooks button). Send a POST with JSON: text supports **bold**, _italic_, `code` and links. Messages with the same thread.key go into the same thread.
guide.cardsBody: Cards in Google Chat's format (cardsV2 or cards) work too: a header, text paragraphs and buttons that open links.
guide.eventsBody: We send a signed POST to your URL when the app is mentioned, DM'd, one of its commands is used, or it's added to or removed from a conversation. Messages from other apps never trigger events.
guide.verifyBody: Always check the signature with your secret before doing anything:
guide.replyBody: To answer right away, return JSON with text and/or cards in the response itself (within 10 seconds). It's posted as the app, in the thread if the event came from one.
guide.asyncBody: To answer later, post with the app's token into any conversation it's a member of (threadRoot to reply in a thread):
guide.limit1: Text up to 8000 characters; up to 5 cards and 10 buttons per section; requests up to 32 KB.
guide.limit2: 60 messages per minute per webhook and per app.
guide.limit3: Up to 120 events per minute per app; your server must answer within 10 seconds and redirects are not followed.
guide.limit4: Secret URLs, tokens and signing secrets are shown only once; keep them somewhere safe.
guide.limit5: The delivery log keeps each app's last 50 attempts.
